name: Flickr30k
description: A dataset of 31,783 Flickr images, each paired with five crowdsourced English descriptions, commonly used for image-text retrieval and related vision-language tasks. This record does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Young, P., Lai, A., Hodosh, M., & Hockenmaier, J. (2014). From image descriptions to visual denotations: New similarity metrics for semantic inference over event descriptions. Transactions of the Association for Computational Linguistics, 2, 67–78. https://doi.org/10.1162/tacl_a_00183
